title: test-integration-svc: 138 failing blocks across 37 files; the reported 'missing tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations ledger' premise was disproven, three unrelated root causes fixed (33 blocks), suite still exits 1
registered_by: BACKEND-DEV (WF03-gh477-20260806 Step 03, incidental discovery during spot-check)
symptom: zig build test-integration-svc exits 1. The issue was filed reporting 63 failing blocks across 34 files with a dominant failure mode of PostgreSQL 42P01 'relation "tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations" does not exist'. Neither figure nor the dominant-mode attribution survived measurement: the actual pre-fix count on a pristine database is 138 failing blocks across 37 files (119 fail + 9 crash + 10 other of 733 total), and the 42P01 lines are stderr bleed from a concurrently running sibling binary, not a failure of any test.
reproduction: docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak; export BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test; zig build test-integration-svc   # exits 1, 63 failing blocks
root_cause_analysis: The filed root cause was disproven (see disproven_premise). Three genuine, mutually independent root causes were found and fixed instead; see root_causes_fixed. They account for 33 of the 119 pre-fix failing blocks measured on a pristine database.
pre_existing_evidence: Control performed during WF03-gh477-20260806 Step 03: with build.zig and tools/clean_test_db.py stashed back to their pre-fix state, against the same healthy db_test database, zig build test-integration-svc failed IDENTICALLY (63 failing blocks, same failure set). The ISS-0148 fix neither causes nor worsens it.
relationship_to_iss0149: Overlapping but not a duplicate. ISS-0149 (GH #465) enumerates 10 failing files under `zig build test-integration`. This set is 34 files and is dominated by a single distinct root cause (missing tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations) that ISS-0149 does not name. Common files: iss202_merge_atomicity_test, iss106_webhook_outbox_test, sch303_timer_dlq_test.
additional_flaky_finding: db_integration_test.TC-DB-02-04 ('invalid pool_size returns InvalidPoolSize; boundary values succeed') fails INTERMITTENTLY - observed failing in 1 of 3 runs, passing in the other 2. It opens a pool at boundary value 200 while db_test runs with max_connections=250, so it is plausibly connection-pressure-sensitive when run alongside other suites. Triage as flakiness, separate from the 63 deterministic failures.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause of 'relation tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations does not exist' identified - specifically why a tenant schema is reachable without its per-tenant migration ledger
zig build test-integration-svc exits 0 against a healthy test database
TC-DB-02-04 either made deterministic or its connection-pressure sensitivity documented and bounded
Any real production defect found during triage is fixed, not just its test
evidence: Post-fix run: zig build test-integration-svc exit 1, 64 failing blocks (scratch/spot-test-integration-svc.log).

Pre-fix control run with build.zig + tools/clean_test_db.py stashed: exit 1, 63 failing blocks (scratch/svc-prefix.log). Set difference is exactly one block - db_integration_test.TC-DB-02-04 - which two subsequent repeat runs showed passing, establishing it as flaky rather than a regression.
Dominant error text: 'POSTGRES ERROR: SERRORVERRORC42P01Mrelation "tenant_135ca087f91841abb2bf17f63594b1eb.schema_migrations" does not existP13Fparse_relation.cL1371RparserOpenTable'.
resolution: The reported root cause was disproven. The tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations does not exist lines are stderr bleed from a concurrently running sibling binary, captured inside the output block of an unrelated failing test (TC-ISS503-01). Per-tenant ledger tables are intentionally absent: the canonical tracker is public.schema_migrations(schema_name, version) per src/design/iss504_migration_tracking.md, and GBL-132_iss0108_drop_stray_tenant_schema_migrations.sql deliberately drops any stray per-tenant copies. Tenant provisioning is not defective. Three genuine, independent root causes were found and fixed instead: (RC-1) migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql was renamed to GBL-123 by commit db362fd but tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig still read the old filename, so TC-ISS503-01/02/03 failed with FileNotFound before running any SQL; (RC-2) xc05/xc06 fixtures wrote to a table named `instances` that has never existed in any schema (the projection table is instance_projections), named a created_at column that does not exist (it is started_at), omitted the NOT NULL definition_id, and probed information_schema for table_schema='public' when the business tables live in tenant_default; (RC-3) six OIDC test files wrote unqualified INSERT INTO tenant (... tenant_type ...) which, under the TestHarness search_path of tenant_default,public, resolved to a stale tenant_default.tenant shadow copy that lacks the tenant_type column added by GBL-119 to public.tenant only. Measured on two freshly created and separately migrated databases so the only difference is the source change: 119 failing blocks BEFORE, 86 AFTER. 33 blocks fixed, 0 regressions. zig build test still exits 0.
prevention: When a migration file is renamed, grep tests/ for the old filename in the same commit - a test that reads a migration by name is as much a caller as a SQL reference is. When a test fails with a PostgreSQL error, confirm the error belongs to that test before diagnosing from it: Zig attributes a test binary's interleaved stderr to whichever block was running, so a sibling's transient output is routinely misread as the failing test's cause. Measure integration suite pass/fail counts on a freshly created and migrated database, never on the long-lived shared one - the shared bpm_test database carries a baked-in ordering artifact (1134_iss0112_add_secret_ref_to_tenant_schemas.sql recorded applied 43 minutes before GBL-128_exp501_secrets.sql, so its columns were never added and never will be) that produces 4 phantom failures absent from any clean database.
forwarded: ISS-0182 / GH #515 - effects_subsystem_test: wall-clock backoff assertions and leaked allocations (13 blocks)
ISS-0183 / GH #516 - repository_test: content_hash bytea/uuid mismatch and untyped SQL parameters (11 blocks)
ISS-0184 / GH #517 - remaining 62 blocks across 31 files (audit/webhook/entity/env/adp clusters)

disproven_premise.claim: A per-tenant schema_migrations ledger table is never created during tenant provisioning, making a tenant schema reachable without its own migration ledger; tenant provisioning is therefore defective.
disproven_premise.verdict: DISPROVEN - not a defect; the described state is the intended design.
evidence: Per-tenant ledgers are INTENTIONALLY absent. The canonical tracker is public.schema_migrations(schema_name, version) per src/design/iss504_migration_tracking.md.
GBL-132_iss0108_drop_stray_tenant_schema_migrations.sql exists specifically to DROP stray per-tenant copies, establishing their absence as deliberate.

The three 42P01 lines sit inside the captured output block of TC-ISS503-01, whose real failure is error.FileNotFound at tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig:132 - it failed before executing any SQL. Zig attributes a test binary's interleaved stderr to whichever block was running, so a concurrent sibling's output was misread as this test's cause.
Confirmed on a freshly migrated database: 108/108 migrations applied, zero per-tenant ledger tables created, and no 42P01 error raised.
disproven_premise.consequence: Tenant provisioning is NOT defective. A fix implementing per-tenant ledgers would have contradicted the ISS-504 design.

root_causes_fixed.title: Migration renamed GBL-084 -> GBL-123 by commit db362fd (GH #405); the test still read the old filename
root_causes_fixed.detail: tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig opened migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql from disk after the file had been renamed to GBL-123_rls_removal.sql, so readGbl084Sql() returned error.FileNotFound and TC-ISS503-01/02/03 failed before running any SQL.

root_causes_fixed.title: xc05/xc06 fixtures wrote to `instances`, a table that has never existed in any schema
root_causes_fixed.detail: The projection table is instance_projections (created under that name by 005_instances.sql). The same fixtures also named a created_at column (the real column is started_at), omitted definition_id which is NOT NULL with no default, and TC-XC-06-01 probed information_schema for table_schema='public' while the business tables live in tenant_default because non-GBL migrations apply per tenant schema.

root_causes_fixed.title: Six OIDC files wrote unqualified INSERT INTO tenant (... tenant_type ...), hitting a stale tenant_default shadow copy
root_causes_fixed.detail: TestHarness sets search_path to tenant_default,public, so an unqualified write resolves to tenant_default.tenant - a stale duplicate lacking the tenant_type column that GBL-119_env01_tenant_type_field.sql added to public.tenant only (C42703, 23 occurrences). Every reference was qualified as public.tenant. The underlying public/tenant_default duplication is the systemic cause and is forwarded as ISS-0185 / GH #518.
